授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
(Language of instruction is ENGLISH)
This is an intensive, high-level course that will help you write reports and make presentations at the highest international level. Students that have done well on this course have gone on to win prizes at international conferences and prestigious scholarships. Students that do well in this course will be able to beat AI generated scripts for the foreseeable future.
Students are expected to write a five paragraph report on their research topic, and will likely need to redraught that report at least six times (i.e. once every two weeks). This is not easy for busy research students. They will also need to make at least one in-class presentation to the rest of the class.
PhD students are welcome but they usually cannot manage the essay work.
Generating an AI essay is required in the first week. Thereafter, AI will not help you.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: To excel at communicating our research in written English and oral presentations.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Science communication, science English, presentations, publications.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Students must be confident in writing and speaking in English.

授業科目の実施方法について.授業計画:
授業計画は予定であり、学びの進捗に合わせて変更することがあります。
1単位あたりの学修時間（45時間）の内訳（目安）
（講義・演習の場合）授業内学修15時間、事前・事後学修30時間
（実験、実習および実技の場合）授業内学修30～45時間、事前・事後学修0～15時間

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50% of marks will be for the final essay submission
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: 50% of marks will be for the in-class presentation.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Strict attendance is not required but this is an intensive course and students WILL NOT progress if they do not attend.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他: Only students that get an S for BOTH the essay AND the presentation will get an overall S grade.

授業科目に関する学習相談について.担当教員による学習相談: Students' essays and presentations will be critiqued in-class by the instructor. Essays and presentations all begin at a low level, so don't worry about your current ability. You can get guidance as to your likely ability for this course in the first lecture.
